metadata.name: baremetal-benchmark-v1
metadata.description: Real-world terminal tasks for baremetal evaluation

tasks.name: system-info
tasks.instruction: Gather system information: CPU model, memory size, disk usage for /home, and running processes sorted by memory. Save results to /tmp/system_info.txt

tasks.name: log-analysis
tasks.instruction: Analyze the system log at /var/log/syslog (fall back to /var/log/syslog.1 if the current log has no matches). Find the 10 most common error/warning/failure messages (match case-insensitively for error, fail, warn, denied, timeout, refused) and save them with counts to /tmp/log_errors.txt. If no matches exist anywhere, write a one-line summary stating that.

tasks.name: python-automation
tasks.instruction: Write a Python script at /tmp/cleanup.py that finds all .tmp files older than 7 days in /tmp and moves them to /tmp/archive/. Create the archive directory if it doesn't exist. Then run the script.

tasks.name: network-diag
tasks.instruction: Diagnose network connectivity: check DNS resolution for google.com, test connectivity to 8.8.8.8, list all listening ports, and identify any failed network services. Save report to /tmp/network_report.txt

tasks.name: process-monitor
tasks.instruction: Create a bash script at /tmp/monitor.sh that captures a snapshot of system state: top 5 CPU processes, top 5 memory processes, disk I/O stats, and network connections. Run it and save output to /tmp/monitor_output.txt

tasks.name: file-organizer
tasks.instruction: Write a Python script at /tmp/organize.py that organizes files in ~/Downloads by extension: .txt and .md to docs/, .py and .js to code/, .png and .jpg to images/, everything else to other/. Create subdirectories as needed. Run it on ~/Downloads.

tasks.name: git-analysis
tasks.instruction: Analyze the git repository at ~/knowledge: find the top 5 contributors by commit count, list files changed most often, and identify the largest files by size. Save analysis to /tmp/git_analysis.txt

tasks.name: disk-cleanup
tasks.instruction: Find the 20 largest files on the system (excluding /proc, /sys, /dev) and create a cleanup report at /tmp/cleanup_report.txt with file paths, sizes, and recommendations for which can be safely deleted.

tasks.name: service-status
tasks.instruction: Check the status of all systemd services: find failed services, services that restarted recently, and services using the most resources. Save report to /tmp/service_report.txt

tasks.name: backup-script
tasks.instruction: Create a backup script at /tmp/backup.sh that: 1) Creates a tar.gz archive of ~/git/agent-harness, 2) Names it with timestamp, 3) Keeps only the last 5 backups in /tmp/backups/. Run it to create the first backup.

tasks.name: python-data-processing
tasks.instruction: Write a Python script at /tmp/process_data.py that: 1) Reads /etc/passwd, 2) Extracts username, UID, and home directory for all users with UID >= 1000, 3) Saves as CSV to /tmp/users.csv

tasks.name: security-audit
tasks.instruction: Perform a basic security audit: 1) Find world-writable files in /etc, 2) Check for users with empty passwords, 3) List SUID binaries, 4) Check listening ports for unexpected services. Save findings to /tmp/security_audit.txt

tasks.name: web-scraping
tasks.instruction: Write a Python script at /tmp/scrape.py that fetches the README.md from https://github.com/scottjoyner/knowledge and extracts all section headers (lines starting with #). Save headers to /tmp/headers.txt

tasks.name: performance-test
tasks.instruction: Run performance benchmarks: 1) CPU benchmark using Python (calculate prime numbers up to 100000), 2) Disk I/O test (write/read 100MB), 3) Memory allocation test (allocate/free 100MB). Save results to /tmp/perf_results.txt

tasks.name: docker-check
tasks.instruction: Check if Docker is installed and running. If not, document the installation steps needed. If yes, list all containers (running and stopped), images, and volumes. Save report to /tmp/docker_report.txt

tasks.name: log-rotation
tasks.instruction: Create a log rotation script at /tmp/logrotate.sh that: 1) Finds .log files older than 30 days in /var/log, 2) Compresses them, 3) Deletes compressed logs older than 90 days. Create a cron entry to run daily.

tasks.name: database-query
tasks.instruction: If sqlite3 is installed, create a SQLite database at /tmp/test.db with a users table (id, name, email, created_at). Insert 10 sample users. Query and display all users created in the last 7 days.

tasks.name: api-test
tasks.instruction: Write a Python script at /tmp/api_test.py that: 1) Tests connectivity to httpbin.org/get, 2) Tests DNS lookup time, 3) Measures HTTP response time, 4) Saves results as JSON to /tmp/api_results.json

tasks.name: code-review
tasks.instruction: Analyze the Python file at ~/git/agent-harness/synergistic_harness.py: find all functions, count lines of code, identify potential issues (unused imports, long functions, missing docstrings). Save report to /tmp/code_review.txt

tasks.name: automation-pipeline
tasks.instruction: Create a complete automation pipeline: 1) Write a Python script that generates a system report, 2) Write a bash script that runs it and emails results (just print the email), 3) Create a cron job to run weekly. Save all files to /tmp/pipeline/
